objective: Definir el contrato puro de renovacion, prorrateo y vigencia contractual de Cavas sin DDL ni cambios de persistencia. Debe soportar alta a mitad de ciclo, corte comun configurable, primer periodo prorrateado, renovaciones posteriores de periodo completo, periodo de gracia configurable e historial por periodo. No hardcodear meses, fechas, dias de gracia ni porcentajes. Mantener separado contrato vigente, periodo contractual y estado de renovacion.

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    ContractPeriod,
    ContractPeriodKind,
    RenewalPolicy,
    RenewalStatus,
    calculate_prorated_amount,
    derive_renewal_status,
    validate_contract_period,
    validate_renewal_policy,
)


def test_renewal_policy_is_configurable_not_calendar_hardcoded():
    validate_renewal_policy(RenewalPolicy(cycle_start_month=7, cycle_start_day=15, grace_days=20, upcoming_notice_days=45))
    validate_renewal_policy(RenewalPolicy(cycle_start_month=1, cycle_start_day=1, grace_days=0, upcoming_notice_days=10))


def test_initial_period_can_be_prorated():
    assert calculate_prorated_amount(12000, 183, 366) == 6000.0
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calculate_prorated_amount(12000, 367, 366)


def test_initial_prorated_period_cannot_exceed_annual_base():
    period = ContractPeriod(
        period_id="PER-1", contract_id="CTR-1", kind=ContractPeriodKind.INITIAL_PRORATED,
        valid_from="2026-07-01", valid_to="2026-12-31", annual_base_amount=12000,
        charged_amount=6000, renewal_status=RenewalStatus.VIGENTE,
    )
    validate_contract_period(period)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_contract_period(ContractPeriod(
            period_id="PER-X", contract_id="CTR-1", kind=ContractPeriodKind.INITIAL_PRORATED,
            valid_from="2026-07-01", valid_to="2026-12-31", annual_base_amount=12000,
            charged_amount=13000, renewal_status=RenewalStatus.VIGENTE,
        ))


def test_full_renewal_preserves_link_to_previous_period():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_contract_period(ContractPeriod(
            period_id="PER-2", contract_id="CTR-1", kind=ContractPeriodKind.FULL_RENEWAL,
            valid_from="2027-01-01", valid_to="2027-12-31", annual_base_amount=12000,
            charged_amount=12000, renewal_status=RenewalStatus.RENOVADA,
        ))
    validate_contract_period(ContractPeriod(
        period_id="PER-2", contract_id="CTR-1", kind=ContractPeriodKind.FULL_RENEWAL,
        valid_from="2027-01-01", valid_to="2027-12-31", annual_base_amount=12000,
        charged_amount=12000, renewal_status=RenewalStatus.RENOVADA, previous_period_id="PER-1",
    ))


def test_renewal_status_uses_configurable_windows():
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=60, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30) == RenewalStatus.VIGENTE
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=20, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30) == RenewalStatus.PROXIMA_A_RENOVAR
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=0, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30) == RenewalStatus.RENOVACION_PENDIENTE
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=-10, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30) == RenewalStatus.PERIODO_DE_GRACIA
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=-16, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30) == RenewalStatus.VENCIDA


def test_blocked_and_renewed_are_explicit_states():
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=-100, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30, renewed=True) == RenewalStatus.RENOVADA
    assert derive_renewal_status(days_until_end=100, grace_days=15, upcoming_notice_days=30, blocked=True) == RenewalStatus.BLOQUEADA
